name: Free public dental care (Queensland)
summary: Free public dental care for Queensland adults with a Health Care Card or other eligible concession card.
key: Public dental services are provided free to eligible people.
who: Receive benefits from an eligible concession card, including the Health Care Card
how: Contact your local public dental service to check eligibility, book or join the waiting list
catches: Waiting lists apply; you pay your own transport to the clinic.

evidence.quote: Public dental services in Queensland are funded by the government and are provided free to eligible people.
For adults and their dependants to be eligible for free public dental care they must be a Queensland resident
